# PersonMatchCriteria

Used directly by: [`findPerson`](../operations/findPerson.md)

Match criteria. Every field is optional in the sense that the API never rejects a sparse body — but matching only happens once the criteria reach one of these minimum combinations:

- firstName + lastName + emails[].email
- firstName + lastName + phones[].phoneNumber
- firstName + lastName + addresses[].zipOrPostalCode (zip5) + dateOfBirth
- firstName + lastName + addresses[].addressLine1 (street number **and** street name) + addresses[].zipOrPostalCode (zip5)
- emails[].email on its own (phones[].phoneNumber on its own also works)

Below that, the request is answered Unmatched without a search rather than rejected. A valid vanId overrides all other criteria and skips the threshold entirely.

| Property | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vanId` | integer or null | VAN id of the person; a valid vanId overrides all other criteria and is looked up directly, with no minimum-combination threshold. Warning: the API returns 500 for vanId 0. |
| `firstName` | string or null | Required by every combination except the email-only (or phone-only) one. Compared case- and accent-insensitively, and may match nicknames and variants unless the context has "Disable Partial Matching" enabled. A first name that disagrees with the person record turns an otherwise-matching request into Unmatched. |
| `middleName` | string or null | Never part of a minimum combination; only narrows a match that the other criteria already reached. |
| `lastName` | string or null | Required by every combination except the email-only (or phone-only) one. Same comparison rules as firstName. |
| `dateOfBirth` | string (date) or null | Only reaches the threshold in combination with firstName, lastName and a zip5 in addresses[]. Name + dateOfBirth alone returns Unmatched. |
| `emails` | array of object or null | Email addresses to match on. The strongest single criterion: an address on its own reaches the threshold, no name required. Compared case-insensitively. |
| `phones` | array of object or null | Phone numbers to match on. Reaches the threshold with firstName + lastName, and — undocumented but observed — on its own as well. Punctuation is ignored: "907-555-4242" matches a stored "9075554242". A null array entry returns 500. |
| `addresses` | array of [PersonMatchAddress](../schemas/PersonMatchAddress.md) or null | Addresses to match on — the only way to supply the zip5 that two of the minimum combinations require. Never sufficient on its own, and never with a name alone: firstName + lastName + zipOrPostalCode returns Unmatched unless a dateOfBirth or a street address comes with it. A null entry in this array is tolerated (404 Unmatched, not 500). |

`*` = required.
